name: anchor_support_threshold
what_it_rejects: Junctions where left_anchor < normal_anchor or right_anchor < normal_anchor (default config.junction_support=10; StringTie default 5 — Rustle 2x stricter for normal introns)

name: long_intron_anchor_threshold
what_it_rejects: Long introns (> config.longintron): requires anchor >= LONGINTRONANCHOR (25bp hardcoded) instead of normal_anchor; StringTie uses per-read logic without explicit long-intron anchor elevation

name: mm_negative_rejection
what_it_rejects: Junctions with mm < 0 (demotion marker from long-read higher analysis) when nreads_good <= 0; StringTie accepts mm<0 on raw read support, Rustle default rejects them → over-segmentation

name: strand_zero_rejection
what_it_rejects: Junctions with strand==0 (ambiguous/stranded from paired conflicting reads); hardcoded rejection in bundle filtering before graph creation

name: good_junc_donor_coverage_drop
what_it_rejects: Junctions failing StringTie good_junc donor-side coverage-drop check: kill if lleftcov > 10.0 AND leftsupport * 100 < 0.1 * lleftcov AND (mismatch OR lrightcov > lleftcov*0.9)

name: good_junc_acceptor_coverage_drop
what_it_rejects: Junctions failing StringTie good_junc acceptor-side coverage-drop check: kill if rrightcov > 10.0 AND rightsupport * 100 < rrightcov * 0.1 AND (mismatch OR rleftcov > rrightcov*0.9)

name: isofrac_junction_reads_ratio
what_it_rejects: Junctions where mrcount * 10 < 0.1 * leftsupport OR mrcount * 10 < 0.1 * rightsupport (junction reads must be >= 1% of splice-site support); part of good_junc check

name: st_relaxed_nreads_good_skip
what_it_rejects: In default (non-ST-strict) mode: junctions with nm <= 0 or nm < mrcount are skipped from good_junc check entirely (Rustle relaxation); ST-strict mode applies checks to all junctions

name: nreads_good_threshold_st_strict
what_it_rejects: ST-strict mode: junctions with nreads_good < 1.25 * junction_thr are killed outright (matches ST rlink.cpp:15419); default mode skips this for low-mismatch junctions

name: weak_alt_junction_coalescing
what_it_rejects: Alt-donor/acceptor junctions within RUSTLE_ALT_JUNC_WINDOW (default 100bp) of canonical with < min_ratio * canonical_reads (default 0.5); requires >= min_siblings (default 2) alt-junctions at same acceptor/donor

name: skip_junction_mini_exon_rejection
what_it_rejects: Long-intron junctions (D,A) when sub-junctions (D,A') and (D'',A) with min_ratio=10x support (A' < D'' mini-exon) exist; rejects the long junction to bypass false mini-exons

name: spurious_mini_exon_rejection
what_it_rejects: Sub-junctions (D,A') and (D'',A) when high-support long junction (D,A) exists with reads_long > min_ratio * reads_sub (default min_ratio=10); demotes both sub-junctions

name: pair_witness_junction_filter
what_it_rejects: Multi-exon transcripts (>= 3 exons) whose consecutive junction pairs lack witness in junction_pair_stats (read co-occurrence count); requires RUSTLE_PAIR_WITNESS=1 env flag to enable

name: min_junction_support_filter
what_it_rejects: Multi-exon transcripts whose weakest junction has < min_reads support (checked via nreads_good); unless longcov >= cov_exemption_threshold (default 10) or guide-derived

name: isofrac_longunder_filter
what_it_rejects: Multi-exon transcripts with longcov < isofrac * (sum of overlapping multi-exon longcov) (default isofrac=0.01); exempts guide/oracle/rescue-derived transcripts

name: Alt-junction coalescing (weak sibling demotion)
what_it_rejects: Weak alt-donor and alt-acceptor junctions with low read support that cluster near high-read canonical junctions; demotes them so they don't create separate graph-node boundaries

name: Skip-junction rejection (mini-exon bypass)
what_it_rejects: Long-intron junctions (D,A) when high-support mini-exon sub-junctions (D,A') and (D'',A) exist with reads >= min_ratio*long_reads; demotes the skip junction

name: Spurious mini-exon rejection
what_it_rejects: Low-support sub-junctions (D,A') and (D'',A) when a high-support long junction (D,A) already spans the mini-exon; demotes both sub-junctions

name: Graph-level alt-junction coalescing (weak donors/acceptors in node-building)
what_it_rejects: Alt-donor and alt-acceptor coordinates at graph-node boundaries that cluster within N bp of canonical junctions with < min_ratio reads; prevents creation of separate graph nodes

name: Longtrim strict read-boundary thresholds
what_it_rejects: Lend events with < RUSTLE_LONGTRIM_STRICT_MIN_READS (default 5.0) accumulated reads or tmpcov < RUSTLE_LONGTRIM_STRICT_MIN_TMPCOV (default 20.0); stricter than default (3.0 reads, 25.0 tmpcov)

name: Longtrim ratio gate (coverage-contrast ratio filtering)
what_it_rejects: Source-trim (lstart) splits where avg_left / avg_right >= threshold (default 0.2), and sink-trim (lend) splits where avg_right / avg_left >= threshold; gates on 50bp window coverage ratio

name: Bundle-building strict coverage boundaries
what_it_rejects: Group boundary extensions (start/end) that violate hard-boundary markers (hardstart/hardend set from read alignment endpoints); prevents merging of groups separated by marked boundaries

name: Bundle merge hard-boundary veto
what_it_rejects: Merging of close groups when either group is marked with hardstart/hardend during merge_close_groups; prevents collapsing read-aligned boundary markers

name: Zero-width node compaction
what_it_rejects: Empty graph nodes [X,X) created by coincident junction donor/acceptor events; merges them via transitive closure to reduce over-segmentation

name: Micro-exon (CHI_THR=50bp) filtering in bundle groups
what_it_rejects: Exons < 50bp or (long-read AND < 50bp AND < 50% of read length) lacking good junctions on both sides; trims small terminal exons from bundles

name: Junction mmcount<0 demotion (layer 2.5 shadow)
what_it_rejects: Junctions with nreads_good < 5 and consleft=0 (non-canonical) that don't coordinate with surviving junctions; demotes so they don't create node boundaries

name: Coverage-link recursion through zero-coverage nodes
what_it_rejects: Source/sink edge decisions that don't recurse through zero-coverage phantom nodes to find true ancestor coverage; makes source/sink edge addition stricter by detecting hidden high-coverage parents

name: KEEPTRF_RET2_LEGACY strict guard
what_it_rejects: In ret=2 (kept extends past tf), when RUSTLE_KEEPTRF_RET2_LEGACY=1 is set, refuses to fold any transfrag with a hard/long boundary (hardstart/hardend or longstart/longend), which is stricter than StringTie's rlink.cpp:5736-5749 that has NO such inner guard

name: SHORT_TF_STRICT keeptrf gate
what_it_rejects: When RUSTLE_SHORT_TF_STRICT=1 (opt-in), for transfrags with ≤2 nodes, requires BOTH boundary evidence (longstart and longend), preventing short mid-chain transfrags from becoming keeptrf seeds

name: FLOW_SUBSEQ_PROTECT transfrag depletion
what_it_rejects: Default ON: prevents depletion of transfrags whose intron chain is NOT a contiguous subsequence of the flow path (catches skip-cassette variants with different junctions than the path). StringTie's rlink.cpp:8627-8665 has NO subseq protection and depletes every transfrag with flow>0. Opt-out via RUSTLE_FLOW_SUBSEQ_PROTECT_OFF=1

name: FULL_CHAIN_WITNESS K-intron window witness
what_it_rejects: Default ON: requires full K-intron windows (default K=4) to be witnessed by at least one transfrag or collectively tiled by multiple reads with ≥1 intron overlap or ≤max_gap introns gap (default gap=2 pre-predcluster, 0 post-predcluster). StringTie has no equivalent. Catches chimeric chains whose K-intron windows lack read support. Opt-out via RUSTLE_FULL_CHAIN_WITNESS_OFF=1

name: FULL_CHAIN_WITNESS_TERMINAL_STRICT
what_it_rejects: When RUSTLE_FULL_CHAIN_WITNESS_TERMINAL_STRICT=1 (opt-in), enforces strict K-window witness check on terminal windows (first and last K-windows). Default behavior skips terminal windows when n_windows ≥ 3 to relax graph-derived 5'/3' boundary junctions. Stricter mode checks all windows

name: FULL_CHAIN_WITNESS_SINGLE_ONLY
what_it_rejects: When RUSTLE_FULL_CHAIN_WITNESS_SINGLE_ONLY=1 (opt-in), requires K-intron windows to be witnessed by a SINGLE read rather than allowing collective tiling from multiple reads. Stricter than default collective mode

name: FULL_CHAIN_WITNESS_GAP coverage tolerance
what_it_rejects: Tunable max intron gap allowed between tiled read segments in collective witness mode (default 2 pre-predcluster, 0 post-predcluster). Smaller values (down to 0) strictly require direct consecutive coverage without jumping over unwitnessed skip junctions

name: FULL_CHAIN_WITNESS_K window size
what_it_rejects: Tunable minimum K consecutive introns required for full-chain witness validation (default 4). Larger K values are stricter and catch longer unchained windows

name: TERMINAL_EDGE_INJECT synthesis
what_it_rejects: When RUSTLE_TERMINAL_EDGE_INJECT=1 (opt-in), synthesizes source/sink helper edges for real transfrags lacking direct connectivity to source/sink. StringTie's futuretr adds these unconditionally; Rustle's default skips them. This opt-in adds edges more aggressively than default Rustle behavior

name: TRFLONG_PASS2_OFF seed selection
what_it_rejects: Default ON (Pass 2 enabled): adds complete or guide transfrags as seeds even when incomplete (rlink.cpp:6470-6477). With RUSTLE_TRFLONG_PASS2_OFF=1 (opt-out), skips Pass 2 and includes only incomplete non-guide seeds, being stricter about what becomes a seed (parity experiments only)

name: TRFLONG_SINK_COMPLETION boundary walk
what_it_rejects: When RUSTLE_TRFLONG_SINK_COMPLETION=1 (opt-in), allows transfrags' last nodes to reach sink via forward-chain walk (indirect hardend/sink reachability). Default OFF matches StringTie; enabled mode is more lenient (sensitivity), not stricter. NOT a stricter option

name: Survival gate (cov/readthr/length)
what_it_rejects: Predictions with coverage < 1.0 (READTHR) or exonic_len < 200bp; guides exempt

name: Retained intron (lowintron-gated)
what_it_rejects: Contained predictions whose exons bridge a low-coverage intron of a higher-cov container; gates on per-base coverage mask; guides exempt

name: Included drop (pairwise containment)
what_it_rejects: Contained multi-exon predictions i (cov_i <= cov_j * 0.5); introns(i) subset of introns(j), significant overlap required; guides exempt

name: Isofrac longunder (per-maxint, long-read only)
env_flag: RUSTLE_PREDCLUSTER_ST (gates entire ST-faithful path, default OFF)
what_it_rejects: Multi-exon predictions cov < isofraclong * max(usedcov, multicov); coverage-gated isofraclong (0.005-0.01); guides exempt; single-exon: cov < isofraclong * usedcov

name: Isofrac filter (pre-predcluster, legacy)
env_flag: RUSTLE_ISOFRAC_TLEN_NORM, RUSTLE_ISOFRAC_ST_COV, RUSTLE_ISOFRAC_TLEN_EXP, RUSTLE_ISOFRAC_PER_MAXINT (tuning flags); isofrac param passed in
what_it_rejects: Predictions cov < effective_frac * max_cov (single-exon) or multicov (multi-exon); isofrac and single_exon_stricter params; coverage-scaled isofrac for high-cov; synthetic exempt

name: Low-coverage singleton chains
env_flag: RUSTLE_FILTER_LOW_COV_SINGLETONS (set to threshold value to enable; default 2.0)
what_it_rejects: Multi-exon transcripts with coverage < 1.0 whose intron chain appears only once at locus; guides, multi-instance chains, shared-locus chains exempt

name: Chimeric zero-novel (requires ref GTF)
what_it_rejects: Multi-exon predictions with zero novel introns that are chimeric combinations (introns from disjoint ref-tx groups); guides, oracle, ref-chain-rescue exempt

name: Zero-novel proper subset (requires ref GTF)
what_it_rejects: Multi-exon predictions with zero novel introns whose chain is proper subset of single ref tx (end-truncated/contained); guides, oracle, ref-chain-rescue, exact-chain TPs exempt

name: Zero-novel not-exact (requires ref GTF)
what_it_rejects: Multi-exon predictions with zero novel introns whose exact intron chain is NOT in reference (chimeric combinations not matching any single ref tx); guides, oracle, ref-chain-rescue exempt

name: Singleton novel junctions (requires ref GTF)
what_it_rejects: Predictions whose novel introns each appear in only this transcript (singleton novel junctions); spares chains with shared exon structure; guides, oracle exempt

name: Dominated novel junctions (requires ref GTF)
what_it_rejects: Predictions whose novel introns are all dominated by other transcripts' usage at same locus; guides, oracle exempt

name: Isofrac longunder (post-predcluster, opt-in)
what_it_rejects: Multi-exon predictions cov < 0.01 * overlapping_multicov (per-locus; tunable); guides, oracle, ref-chain-rescue exempt

name: Cross-strand retained intron
env_flag: RUSTLE_CROSS_STRAND_KRI=1 (legacy enable); RUSTLE_CROSS_STRAND_DRY_RUN=1 (dry-run); RUSTLE_CROSS_STRAND_MIN_COV=N (default 50.0); RUSTLE_CROSS_STRAND_DEBUG=1; RUSTLE_STRAND_PURE_MINORITY_OFF (disable auto-enable)
what_it_rejects: Low-cov antisense transcripts (cov < cov_threshold) whose exons bridge high-cov same-chrom introns of opposite-strand neighbor; guides exempt; revives sole-gene survivors

name: ST-port soft gate (parse_trflong back/fwd)
what_it_rejects: Seeds where rustle's path reconstruction succeeds but StringTie's strict algorithm would fail — routes over-extended candidates to checktrf instead of flow storage; treats weak/inconsistent transfrags as completion-path artifacts

name: Min coverage gate (flow store)
what_it_rejects: Seeds with coverage < 0.15 (default) are rejected from flow storage and deferred to checktrf; stricter than StringTie's epsilon gate; filters ultra-low-coverage FP predictions that clutter predcluster

name: Flow-redundancy dedup (checktrf)
what_it_rejects: Checktrf rescues whose junction chain is a sub-chain of a higher-coverage FLOW chain at the same locus (F1 win +0.148pp: -15 FP, -8 TP on GGO_19); suppresses redundant shorter siblings

name: Flow-redundancy dominant-coverage refinement
what_it_rejects: Requires flow-containing chain has STRICTLY HIGHER coverage (not just equal) to suppress rescue; protects genuine alt isoforms that are sub-chains of weaker flow; enables net F1 win by saving ~9 TPs

name: Strict admission gate (checktrf primary)
what_it_rejects: Non-guide transfrags not linked to both source and sink (incomplete bundle-spanning paths); mirrors StringTie's rlink.cpp:10044 primary gate; drops partial/internal seeds that inflate checktrf volume vs ST

name: Checktrf sort by abundance
what_it_rejects: Processes checktrf candidates in DESCENDING abundance order (StringTie-parity); prevents chimeric long-reads from being rescued first and over-extending past gene boundaries; tiebreak on node count DESC

name: Forward extend (checktrf rescue)
what_it_rejects: Suppresses checktrf rescue extension past hardend or back-extended nodes; requires next child to be non-hardend and have real children; prevents k-class over-extension spanning past ref gene + adjacent territory

name: JAB (Junction-Acceptor Bridge) extension
what_it_rejects: Blocks JAB extension when last rescue node ends at incoming-junction boundary with non-contiguous parents; prevents spurious artifactual node-splits from extending the rescue path

name: Junction quality gate (checktrf)
what_it_rejects: Rescues containing any junction NOT in good_junctions set are skipped; targets artifact/noisy-read junctions that never accumulated enough support; opt-in stricter gate

name: Truncated-at-hardend dedup (checktrf)
what_it_rejects: Suppresses rescues that are strict subset of higher-coverage kept chain AND terminate at hardend node with no independent 3' read-end mass (8x FP enrichment: 0.379 FP vs 0.164 TP); removes 3 final-GTF FP for 0 TP loss

name: Subset-of-cosurvivor truncation suppression
what_it_rejects: Drops checktrf rescues that are junction strict subset of higher-coverage kept path AND (default) terminate at hardstart node (spurious 5'-truncation); protects isoforms with strong independent 5' read evidence (reads_start >= 4.0)

name: Back-extend disable (checktrf rescue)
what_it_rejects: Disables back-extension prefix generation in checktrf rescue; blocklist default due to verified double-win (+3 TP, -3 FP, F1 93.30→93.46); back-extend over-inflates false-positive multi-prefix alt-TSS chains

name: Multinode no-match drop (checktrf)
what_it_rejects: DEFAULT-OFF; opt-in only: drops multi-node long-read rescues with no matching kept paths (rlink.cpp gate); gate is NET-NEGATIVE default-on per validation 2026-06-09 (over-rejects 156 StringTie-shared TPs)

name: Zero-flux deferral to checktrf (flow_flux <= 0)
what_it_rejects: Long-read, non-mixed-mode, non-guide seeds with zero/negative flux are deferred to checktrf without flow storage; separates flow paths from rescue candidates; routes low-signal candidates to dedicated rescue logic

name: Strict longrec checktrf deferral
what_it_rejects: Failed direct long-rec seeds are strictly deferred to checktrf for potential rescue; default strict behavior; only diagnostic opt-out available
